name: pi-multi-account
description: Automatic multi-account failover & rotation for Pi Agent across Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI/ChatGPT Codex, Qwen/Alibaba, and Ollama. Auto-discovers authenticated accounts, grows the rotation on login, and drops accounts on logout, expiry, or quota/rate-lim
